title: Reset-Scope Multiplier for Late Recovery Resets
content:
# Reset-scope multiplier

> Harborline Customer Accounts

The reset-scope multiplier of the late-reset goodwill follows what the approved request reset, as its requested change on the recovery request record shows: removing two-factor and changing the sign-in email takes 1.4, changing the sign-in email only takes 1.2, and removing two-factor only takes one. It multiplies the late-reset goodwill figure.

- Remove two-factor and change the sign-in email: 1.4
- Change the sign-in email only: 1.2
- Remove two-factor only: 1

*Hypothetical:* a figure of $7.00 for a request that changed only the sign-in email becomes $8.40.
